projects.title: SDNE measurement validity and XR data quality
projects.outcome: Establish whether SDNE measurements and Samsung XR sensor outputs are sufficiently valid and reliable for their intended use.
projects.problemOpportunity: Measurement validity and hardware data quality must be demonstrated before product claims or scaled use are justified.
projects.nextAction: Verify scope, owner, success criteria, and current Samsung XR evidence against the original idea-dump email and SDNE source documents.
risks: Clinical or product claims could outpace validated evidence.

projects.title: AI Historian
projects.outcome: Create a clinically useful virtual on-video neurologic history workflow with appropriate real-time assistance.
projects.problemOpportunity: Remote encounters need a scalable way to collect structured neurologic history while preserving clinician oversight.
projects.nextAction: Confirm intended users, workflow boundary, evidence requirements, and relationship to the existing OPSAmple historian implementation.
risks: Transcript-derived concept is broad and does not confirm a production scope.

projects.title: Real-time video transcription and translation
projects.outcome: Provide accurate, low-latency transcription and translation during video-based care workflows.
projects.problemOpportunity: Language and documentation friction can reduce access and increase clinician workload in virtual care.
projects.nextAction: Verify whether transcription and translation are one initiative or separate workstreams and define clinical quality thresholds.
risks: Accuracy, latency, language coverage, and consent requirements are not yet verified.

projects.title: Consumer HIE / Patient Data Platform restart
projects.outcome: Determine a viable restart path for a patient-centered health-information platform.
projects.problemOpportunity: The prior concept requires a current problem definition, governance boundary, and restart decision before further build work.
projects.nextAction: Verify the requested follow-up, current repository state, and restart decision criteria without assigning an owner.
risks: Privacy, consent, interoperability, and product ownership remain undefined.

projects.title: Platform and operating-system standardization
projects.outcome: Reduce duplicated systems and standardize high-value internal platform, finance, engineering, and data-quality patterns.
projects.problemOpportunity: Duplicated tools and inconsistent internal patterns increase maintenance cost and weaken operational data quality.
projects.nextAction: Confirm remit, boundaries, accountable owner, and the first duplication-reduction target from an original source.
risks: People-specific remit and ownership are provisional and must not be treated as assigned.

projects.title: Production handoff gates
projects.outcome: Establish explicit readiness gates for moving Product & Innovation work into supported production ownership and Sevaro.com surfaces.
projects.problemOpportunity: Without defined handoff criteria, prototypes can enter production without clear support, security, data, or ownership readiness.
projects.nextAction: Verify the intended recipient, Sevaro.com boundary, and minimum production-readiness checklist.

projects.title: Stroke Demand Forecasting
projects.outcome: Determine whether retrospective data contains meaningful predictive signal before considering operational forecasting.
projects.problemOpportunity: Operational deployment would be premature without evidence that retrospective models predict stroke demand usefully.
projects.nextAction: Define the retrospective cohort, outcome, leakage controls, baseline, and minimum predictive-signal gate.
risks: Retrospective signal may not generalize operationally.

projects.title: Clinical Compass
projects.outcome: Clarify the intended clinical decision-support outcome and determine whether the concept merits discovery.
projects.problemOpportunity: The name is present in the planning input, but the user, problem, and scope are not verified.
projects.nextAction: Recover the original source description and define the user problem before prioritization.
risks: Concept currently has only a name.

projects.title: NeuroColleague
projects.outcome: Clarify the intended clinician collaboration or support outcome and determine whether the concept merits discovery.
projects.problemOpportunity: The planning input names NeuroColleague but does not verify its target user, need, or relationship to existing tools.
projects.nextAction: Recover the source description and check for overlap with AI Historian, Clinical Compass, and Synapse workflows.
risks: Potential overlap with other clinical AI concepts is unresolved.

projects.title: Outpatient Neurology AI Clinic
projects.outcome: Define a safe, operationally viable AI-enabled outpatient neurology care model.
projects.problemOpportunity: Outpatient specialty access and navigation are constrained, but the product, service, and staffing boundaries require discovery.
projects.nextAction: Define the clinic's user journey, clinical accountability, staffing assumptions, and relationship to multi-specialty pilots.
risks: Clinical accountability and service-model assumptions are not confirmed.

projects.title: Synapse workflow platform
projects.outcome: Provide a reusable virtual-specialty workflow layer spanning navigation, scheduling, clinical documentation, and hospital integration.
projects.problemOpportunity: Virtual specialty services need a consistent workflow footprint across hospitals with different native infrastructure.
projects.nextAction: Map the minimum shared workflow, integration variants, consent boundary, and first co-development pilot.
risks: The transcript emphasizes multiple hospital scenarios and integration assumptions that require explicit mapping.

projects.title: Clinical workflow and multi-hospital deployment
projects.outcome: Standardize clinical documentation, recommendations/orders, and deployment patterns across hospital partners.
projects.problemOpportunity: Hospital partners vary in EMR, scheduling, consent, and documentation infrastructure, creating repeat deployment friction.
projects.nextAction: Document the supported deployment variants and separate universal workflow requirements from site-specific integrations.
risks: Site-specific customization could undermine a portable platform.

projects.title: Sevaro Hub portfolio operating system
projects.outcome: Maintain a traceable project source of truth linked to features, improvements, decisions, sources, and private people IDs.
projects.problemOpportunity: The existing roadmap mixes repositories and milestones, has stale card mappings, and does not support portfolio governance.
projects.nextAction: Validate the new board locally, then obtain review before any commit, push, deployment, or production data update.
risks: The source-controlled board and remote improvement queue can drift without an explicit review cadence.

features.title: Measurement validity evidence
features.problemUserNeed: Product and clinical stakeholders need to know whether each measurement is valid for its intended interpretation.
features.scopeValue: Define validity claims, reference standards, protocols, and decision thresholds before scaling.
acceptanceCriteria: Each intended claim has a defined validation method.
Unsupported claims remain explicitly out of scope.

features.title: Samsung XR data-quality characterization
features.problemUserNeed: The team needs evidence that XR sensor quality is sufficient and its failure modes are observable.
features.scopeValue: Characterize completeness, sampling, invalid states, repeatability, and device-specific limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: Data-quality metrics and failure reasons are defined.
Known hardware limitations are traceable to affected measurements.

features.title: Virtual on-video neurologic historian
features.problemUserNeed: Remote neurology workflows need structured history collection with visible clinician oversight.
features.scopeValue: Define the on-video workflow, prompts, capture boundary, and clinician review points.
acceptanceCriteria: The human oversight and escalation path are explicit.
The system does not imply autonomous clinical decision-making.

features.title: Real-time video transcription
features.problemUserNeed: Clinicians need usable encounter text without waiting for post-visit batch processing.
features.scopeValue: Low-latency transcription with speaker handling and explicit quality states.
acceptanceCriteria: Latency and accuracy targets are defined by workflow.
Low-confidence or failed transcription is visible.

features.title: Real-time video translation
features.problemUserNeed: Patients and clinicians need language access during video care without obscuring uncertainty.
features.scopeValue: Evaluate real-time translation, supported languages, consent, and human interpreter escalation.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported languages and error handling are explicit.
Clinical workflows define when a qualified human interpreter is required.

features.title: Restart decision and follow-up
features.problemUserNeed: Stakeholders need a documented restart/no-restart decision grounded in the current product and governance context.
features.scopeValue: Recover prior work, verify the named follow-up privately, and define decision criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: A source-backed restart decision is recorded.
No owner is assigned until verified.

features.title: Internal operations and finance standardization
features.problemUserNeed: Internal teams need consistent operational and finance workflows with fewer duplicate tools.
features.scopeValue: Inventory duplicate patterns and select one bounded standardization target.
acceptanceCriteria: The first target has a measurable duplication-reduction outcome.

features.title: Engineering data hardening and quality
features.problemUserNeed: Teams need reliable operational data and clear quality ownership.
features.scopeValue: Define data-quality gates, observability, and bounded remediation ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: Quality dimensions and escalation paths are defined before assigning ownership.

features.title: Production readiness and handoff gate
features.problemUserNeed: Receiving teams need a consistent, auditable definition of ready for production ownership.
features.scopeValue: Cover product acceptance, security, privacy, data, support, monitoring, rollback, and ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: Every production handoff identifies an accountable accepting owner.
Incomplete gates remain visible rather than silently waived.

features.title: Phase 1 retrospective predictive-signal study
features.problemUserNeed: Decision-makers need evidence that demand is predictable beyond simple baselines.
features.scopeValue: Run retrospective research with temporal validation, leakage controls, and an operationally relevant baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Performance is compared with a predeclared baseline.
Temporal leakage and calibration are assessed.
A go/no-go threshold is documented before results are known.

features.title: Phase 2 operational deployment
features.problemUserNeed: Operations should use forecasting only if Phase 1 demonstrates meaningful and actionable signal.
features.scopeValue: Define operational workflow and monitoring only after the retrospective gate is met.
acceptanceCriteria: Phase 1 meets the predeclared predictive-signal gate.
Deployment includes drift monitoring and a human decision boundary.

features.title: Clinical documentation footprint
features.problemUserNeed: Contracting and treating organizations need an appropriate record of virtual specialty services in their clinical systems.
features.scopeValue: Define minimum documentation, consent, notification, and EMR communication requirements across integration variants.
acceptanceCriteria: Each deployment variant has an explicit documentation destination.
Consent and access boundaries are reviewed.

features.title: Orders and recommendations workflow
features.problemUserNeed: Virtual specialty recommendations need a clear route into local clinical operations.
features.scopeValue: Separate advisory recommendations from executable orders and map accountability for each scenario.
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendation and order authority are explicit for every deployment model.

features.title: Multi-hospital deployment patterns
features.problemUserNeed: Implementation teams need reusable patterns for hospitals with different infrastructure and specialist-network models.
features.scopeValue: Document supported integration tiers, dependencies, responsibilities, and non-negotiable safety/privacy requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: At least two materially different hospital scenarios are mapped.
Site-specific exceptions do not silently become platform defaults.
